project.name: EIR :: application
project.description:
Use-case orchestration and ports (05 § 2). The layer that gives every control below it a caller: until now SL-1, SL-2, CL-1, RC-1 and DT-1 were live code nothing in src/main constructed, which docs/08 recorded as Phase 5's honest qualification.
Framework-free, and it takes no ADR-0010 exemption. 05 § 2 says "use-case orchestration, transaction boundaries, ports", and the reason all three fit without a framework is that a PORT is an interface this module declares and something outside it implements. Transaction boundaries are declared here as an interface too; eir-batch supplies the Spring-managed implementation, and eir-batch is the module ADR-0010's exemption mechanism exists for.
Depends on eir-domain, eir-calc, eir-policy and eir-gl. Dependencies point strictly inward per 05 § 2, and nothing below this module depends on it — which is what lets a run be assembled here without any of the arithmetic knowing there is a run.
